title: rockmoc deep validation catalog
description: Literature-anchored reference targets for multi-regime solver validation. Each case cites a primary source. Analytical thermo digits match Anderson / NACA isentropic–PM tables (γ=1.4) to published precision.

anderson_naca_isentropic.citation: Standard isentropic & Prandtl–Meyer tables (γ=1.4); Anderson Fundamentals of Aerodynamics; NACA Report 1135 lineage
anderson_naca_isentropic.notes: Closed-form perfect-gas relations; reference digits fixed to commonly published table values

nasa_tm_x_1502.citation: Vanco & Goldman, NASA TM-X-1502 (1968), Computer program for design of two-dimensional supersonic nozzle with sharp-edged throat
nasa_tm_x_1502.notes: Sample Me=4.05, γ=1.36; θ_max=ν_e/2; y_e=A/A*; Δν accuracy discussion Fig. 3

naca_rm_e8j12.citation: Shames & Seashore, NACA RM E8J12 (1948), Design data for graphical construction of two-dimensional sharp-edge-throat supersonic nozzles
naca_rm_e8j12.notes: Graphical construction data M=1.2–10; design rules θ_max=ν_e/2 and y_e/y_t=A/A*

nasa_tm_x_2343.citation: Goldman & Vanco, NASA TM-X-2343 (1971), Computer program for design of two-dimensional supersonic nozzle with boundary-layer correction
nasa_tm_x_2343.notes: BL displacement geometry: r_corr = r_inviscid + δ*

rao_1958.citation: G.V.R. Rao, Exhaust Nozzle Contour for Optimum Thrust, Jet Propulsion / ARS (1958)
rao_1958.notes: TOP length often ~60–90% of 15° conical; θ_n > θ_e engineering correlations

lee_vernacchia_spike.citation: C.C. Lee (1963) annular aerospike; Vernacchia Spike Contour Algorithm notes
lee_vernacchia_spike.notes: δ = π/2 − ν_e; isentropic Prandtl–Meyer plug geometry

sutton_1d_cf.citation: Sutton & Biblarz, Rocket Propulsion Elements — ideal 1-D thrust coefficient
sutton_1d_cf.notes: Cf formula with pe/pc, pa/pc, ε, Me perfect gas

zucrow_hoffman.citation: Zucrow & Hoffman, Gas Dynamics — axisymmetric MOC unit processes
zucrow_hoffman.notes: C± slopes tan(θ±μ); axisym source −sinθ sinμ /(r cos(θ±μ))

nasa_tm_x_1502_sample.name: NASA TM-X-1502 sample planar MLN
nasa_tm_x_1502_sample.mesh_note: TM-X-1502 Fig.3: Δν≈0.1° → ~0.5% x-error, ~0.62% y-error vs zero-Δν limit; Δν≈0.5° → ~2.5% x, ~0.08% y

naca_planar_mln_suite.name: NACA RM E8J12 / planar MLN design-rule suite

family_ordering.name: Design family length ordering (MLN < TIC < ideal typical)
